# NamastePOS

> Mobile-first, offline-ready restaurant POS and billing software for India. Billing, KOT/KDS, table and captain ordering, QR self-ordering, GST invoicing, loyalty and live reports run from an Android phone, an iPhone or the web dashboard, and keep working when the internet drops.

Operator: NamastePOS, India. Founded 2026. Contact: support@namastepos.in

## Who it is for

Single-outlet Indian food businesses - cafes, QSRs, cloud kitchens, dhabas, street-food stalls and small restaurants running 1-3 registers - and small chains of 2-5 outlets. Owner-operated, Android-first, UPI-first, GST-registered. Billed per register.

## What makes it different

- Offline-first billing. Orders are written on the device and replayed idempotently on reconnect, so billing and KOTs continue through an outage and a bill can never be duplicated.
- The phone is the till. No counter PC and no proprietary terminal required. Staff sign in with phone plus PIN, on any Android phone, iPhone or browser.
- GST built in. Server-authoritative pricing, CGST/SGST/IGST and HSN per item, and e-invoice support on the higher plans (see the plan ladder below for exactly where each starts).
- Transparent, all-inclusive pricing. A free-forever plan, paid plans from ₹299 per month, monthly billing, no annual lock-in, and reports on every plan with no report paywall.
- Growth tools included, not sold back. Loyalty points, memberships, prepaid wallet and gift cards, customer CRM, WhatsApp marketing, referrals and QR self-ordering are part of the plan ladder.

## What it does

- Billing and POS: quick bill, token, table and captain modes; variants and modifiers; bill split; split payments across cash, UPI and card
- KOT printing and a live kitchen display system (KDS)
- Table management across floors, plus reservations
- QR self-ordering from the table, with server-side price re-validation
- Invoicing: basic invoices on every plan; GST tax invoices from Pro; e-invoice (GST) from Advanced; TDS/TCS from Enterprise
- Loyalty and points, memberships, prepaid wallet and gift cards, customer CRM
- WhatsApp receipts, order updates and marketing campaigns
- Inventory tracking, recipe costing, dish wastage, dead stock and low-stock alerts
- Expenses, one-tap daily closing, sales and item reports; P&L and balance sheet from Advanced
- Zomato and Swiggy aggregator orders into the same kitchen and the same reports (from Pro)
- Delivery and rider workflows with delivery OTP
- Multi-outlet consolidated reporting, multi-currency, API access and white-label on Enterprise

## Platforms

Android (APK), iOS and a web dashboard. One login works across devices.

## Plan ladder (INR, per register, verified 2026-09-05 against https://api.namastepos.in/v1/public/plans)

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly | Menu items | Staff logins | Tables | Outlets | Monthly orders |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | ₹0 | not offered | 60 | 1 | 8 | 1 | 500 |
| Growth | ₹299 | ₹2,990 | unlimited | 5 | 12 | 1 | 3,000 |
| Pro | ₹799 | ₹7,990 | unlimited | 10 | unlimited | 1 | unlimited |
| Advanced | ₹999 | ₹9,990 | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited | 3 | unlimited |
| Enterprise | ₹1,999 | ₹19,990 | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited | 3 | unlimited |

Yearly billing costs about ten months of the monthly price, so roughly two months free. Free trial: 7 days, no credit card. No annual lock-in, cancel anytime. Add-ons (WhatsApp messaging, e-invoice pack, extra outlets) are sold separately and priced in-product.

Where features start on the ladder, so nothing is implied to be free that is not:

- Starter and Growth include basic invoicing, not GST tax invoices.
- GST tax invoices start on Pro.
- E-invoice (GST) starts on Advanced.
- TDS/TCS and bank reconciliation start on Enterprise.
- Zomato and Swiggy aggregators, inventory tracking and recipe costing start on Pro.
- Accounting (P&L and balance sheet) starts on Advanced.
- Multi-outlet consolidated reporting, multi-currency, API access and white-label are Enterprise.

Machine-readable, always-current source: https://api.namastepos.in/v1/public/plans
